ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.

The complete confidential letter, financial arithmetic, estate transactions, examination/military plans, both preserved source page markers, editorial publication note, and all nine footnotes are represented.

The rhetorical за что я у тебя взял даром лошадей? is rendered why should I have taken the horses from you for nothing?, preserving the argument that the horses compensated Sergei's 1,500-ruble debt rather than implying Tolstoy admits receiving them gratis.
Некому было сечь. Это главное несчастие. remains There was no one to flog me. That is the chief misfortune, without euphemism.
Latin nolens volens is retained; its surrounding sense of compulsory service is not replaced by an English cliché.
